summary.text: Reed Krewson is the Democratic candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an Overland Park Parks and Recreation employee and president of the Kansas Young Democrats.

paragraphs.text: Reed Krewson graduated from Blue Valley Southwest High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 2022 and a graduate degree from the University of Kansas in 2025, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Overland Park, holds a bachelor's degree in political science and a Master's in Public Administration, and became a precinct committeeperson when he turned 18.

Krewson said in the survey that he is running on expanding Medicaid, fully funding public schools, and protecting land, air and water, and that he would be the youngest legislator in Topeka if elected.
